ask.title: Swadeshi Sahayak
ask.subtitle: Ask questions about your business expenses and cash flow directly in your language
ask.welcomeMessage: Hello! I am Swadeshi Sahayak — your digital ledger analyst and financial companion. I connect directly to your local ledger database. Ask me about your spending, vendor price differences, unusual transactions, or next month's forecast.
ask.inputPlaceholder: Ask about your business expenses, vendors, or GST...
ask.suggested1: Which category had our highest spend this month?
ask.suggested2: Show me anomalous or off-hours vendor transactions.
ask.suggested3: Who are our top 5 suppliers by total spend?
ask.suggested4: How much can we save by consolidating vendor price variances?
ask.suggested5: What is our spend ratio between travel and supplies?
ask.suggested6: What is our projected expense spend for next month?
ask.fallbackAnswer: Ledger analysis complete, no specific discrepancies found.

about.title: Swadeshi Khata Architecture & Forensic Pipeline
about.subtitle: Multi-stage machine learning and forensic audit engine built for Indian small businesses
about.topologyDesc: Drag to inspect the multi-stage machine learning pipeline
about.stage1: 1. Receipt Ingestion: Image/PDF upload with metadata extraction
about.stage2: 2. Computer Vision: OpenCV grayscale, denoise, deskew, and adaptive threshold
about.stage3: 3. Bilingual OCR: EasyOCR extracting English and Hindi text with character coordinates
about.stage4: 4. Entity Extraction: Pydantic validated parsing with regex fallback
about.stage5: 5. ML Classification: TF-IDF + Random Forest / Logistic Regression / Embeddings
about.stage6: 6. Anomaly & Sentinel: Isolation Forest, Z-score, duplicate fingerprinting, and SQLite ledger
